a: EsAI is a single platform that brings together the most popular AI models.
In one place you can use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, DeepSeek R1, Grok and Perplexity — without switching between different services.
Pick the AI model you need, ask your question and get an answer in seconds.
After signing up you receive welcome bonus credits and can start using EsAI right away.
No. EsAI has no mandatory subscription.
You top up your balance with credits yourself and use them whenever you actually need them.
Credits are EsAI's internal currency.
They are spent on every request to an AI model.
The more powerful the chosen model and the longer the request and response, the more credits are needed.

4.q: Why do different AI models use different amounts of credits?
a: The cost of running AI models varies.
That's why each model spends credits at its own rate.
After every answer EsAI immediately shows how many credits were charged for that specific request.
No. Credits never expire and stay on your balance until you use them.

All payments go through the secure Freedom Pay and YooKassa payment systems.
Yes. Payments are processed by the secure Freedom Pay and YooKassa payment systems.
